subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The code path changes a stuck diagnostic abort from external-abort behavior into retry/failover behavior during active model calls while preserving non-replay behavior for side-effecting tools, which is a session-state and availability policy choice maintainers should own before merge.

options.title: Accept phase-aware classification
options.body: Treat active model-call diagnostic recovery as idle timeout, side-effecting tool recovery as tool timeout, and stale or unknown phases as external abort, with final proof coordinated against #98580.

options.title: Require stricter owner proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers see broader runtime evidence that active model-call tracking and side-effect tool tracking match real recovery phases.

options.title: Pause behind recovery timing
options.body: Wait for #98580 or another recovery-timing decision before deciding whether this downstream classification still lands as-is.

recommendation.title: Accept phase-aware classification
recommendation.body: Treat active model-call diagnostic recovery as idle timeout, side-effecting tool recovery as tool timeout, and stale or unknown phases as external abort, with final proof coordinated against #98580.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the replay-safety requirement and have the clearest recent history across the affected agent/session recovery surfaces.
